name: Bickering
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to respond to conflict with gentleness and patience rather than harsh words or anger, as a soft answer can turn away wrath while grievous words stir it up. Christians are encouraged to bear with the weaknesses of others and to do all things without complaining or disputing, reflecting the comfort and fellowship found in Christ. Trusting in God's sovereign plan and focusing on unity in the Spirit helps believers avoid bickering and maintain peace within the body of Christ.
